topology: saved complete-graph inputs only; no result-based adjacency selection
budget_k_rule: floor(fraction*N), calculated from exact fractions1/10,1/4,1/2; report actual k/N
budget_unit: number of cases referred for detailed analysis, not wall time, money, failure cost or safety risk
boundary_ties: Expected uniform selection without replacement from exact cutoff ties; all boundary cases receive r/e inclusion weight, with sum weights=k

effective_input_equivalence_policy.fire_only: exact shape/dtype/bytes of full61x4 time feature tensor
effective_input_equivalence_policy.global_stats: same time features plus exact three global features
effective_input_equivalence_policy.score_rule: replace each input-equivalent group's endpoint prediction by its arithmetic group mean within model/seed/protocol; never use reference/utility
effective_input_equivalence_policy.other5models: saved endpoint scores unchanged; exact score ties handled uniformly

utility.U: sum(selection_probability*reference_endpoint)/k; expected selected-reference mean, lower is better
utility.U_star: mean of k lowest reference endpoints; retrospective same-budget oracle
utility.U_random: population mean reference endpoint; exact uniform-without-replacement selection expectation
utility.G: U_random-U; positive favors model over random
utility.L: G/(U_random-U_star); random0,oracle1,negative allowed; NA if denominator<=1e-12
utility.numeric_negative_regret_policy: retain raw; display0 only if magnitude<=1e-12; larger negative is implementation failure

execution_gates: explicit root confirmation of this protocol
isolated inference timing completed and no active timing writes
final420 source and all12 independent audits valid
interpretation: Exploratory allocation of finite case-analysis slots to lower archived numerical responses within each fixed test population. No structural safety, fire-resistance or calibrated deployment acceptance guarantee.
